title: Oil Prices Cross $115 a Barrel as Houthi Attacks on Saudi Arabia Stoke Supply Fears
detail: Oil prices rose above $115 per barrel, with Brent nearing $116, as Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabia raised fears for oil supply. Only the headline and summary were available at the time of writing; details of the market move and the attacks are not yet confirmed.

media.caption: Oil prices rise as Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabia stoke supply fears

title: Saudi Arabia Reports Interception of Houthi Drone Targeting Mecca
detail: Saudi Arabia reported intercepting a Houthi drone said to be targeting Mecca. Only the headline was available via a Google News aggregation link; the originating outlet, launch point and damage are not confirmed and the claim has not been independently verified.

title: Saudi-Led Coalition Says It Intercepted Houthi Drone Near Riyadh
detail: The Saudi-led coalition said it intercepted a Houthi drone near Riyadh, per a Middle East Eye live-blog update. Only the headline was available; launch point, damage and any casualties are not confirmed, and the claim is a coalition statement not independently verified.

title: Saudi-Led Coalition Says It Downed Houthi Drone Over Medina; Houthis Deny Attack
detail: The Saudi-led coalition said it shot down a Houthi drone over Medina. The Houthis denied carrying out the attack. The claim is unverified and based on a live-blog summary; launch point and any damage are not confirmed.

media.caption: Saudi coalition reports drones over Mecca and Medina; Houthis deny both
